usedFor: CompanyCam holds job site projects and contacts, and MailerLite adds the people involved as subscribers with “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Updated To Project” in CompanyCam, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A contact attached to a job is a real customer, so they reach your email list.

watchOut: “Comment All” runs on every comment event, so one busy job can update the same subscriber many times.
